usedFor: Every Shopify order adds a row to Google Sheets for a running, shareable list.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every sale becomes one row at once, and a sheet takes your own columns.

watchOut: Sending “New Customer” and “New Order” into one sheet mixes orders with customers, so use separate sheets.
